body: A developer using AI to get abs. Month 1 of the Six-Pack Project starts now, with honest monthly check-ins.

Desk job, side projects, no time. So I'm using the tools I know.
AI builds the training plan around my week. Food stays simple and repeatable. You get the check-ins: same lighting, no flexing tricks, and what slipped as well as the wins.
AI is the planner, not the doctor. Anything about injuries or health goes to a coach or GP.
Hold me accountable. Follow @manrajtalks and ask me in the comments how it is going.
